name: List All Rental Applications Notes
description: Returns all rental applications notes that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[RentalApplicationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by rental application ID; all GET requests must include a filter for [RentalApplicationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom]

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter rental application notes last updated at or after this date/time; all GET requests must include a filter for [RentalApplicationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom]

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of rental application note objects

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the rental application note. A rental application note cannot exceed 63,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The rental application to which the note will be attached

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the rental application note's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the rental application. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
